subject.title: [Feature]:  Non-blocking heartbeat execution to prevent message processing delays

question: Should OpenClaw introduce a separate non-blocking heartbeat execution lane or worker, and what session, delivery, and tool-side-effect isolation contract should it use?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the requested fix changes core heartbeat execution semantics rather than repairing a small broken contract.

options.title: Design a heartbeat isolation lane
options.body: Define and implement a separate heartbeat execution model with explicit session, delivery, busy-state, and tool-side-effect boundaries before changing runtime behavior.

options.title: Limit to current mitigations
options.body: Keep the awaited heartbeat turn model and improve narrower mitigations such as retry cadence, idle timeout, isolatedSession, lightContext, and timeout behavior through their canonical issues.

options.title: Decline the core execution change
options.body: Decide that current heartbeat primitives are sufficient and close the direction in favor of configuration-level mitigations.

recommendation.title: Design a heartbeat isolation lane
recommendation.body: Define and implement a separate heartbeat execution model with explicit session, delivery, busy-state, and tool-side-effect boundaries before changing runtime behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent heartbeat runner, wake, docs, timeout, and product-review history in the inspected evidence.
